context_note: Descriptive career and recent-form surface win rates as of the corpus end -- not a prediction and not an edge claim. Per-surface floors apply (n>=30 career for a surface win rate, n>=25 each side for the clay-minus-hard gap, n>=15 for grass adaptation), evaluated independently for career and recent form; a metric below its floor shows n/a and is never fabricated. Nothing here adjusts for era, opponent quality, draw, or injury.
